verdict.rationale: The evidence implies an explorable, runnable API surface without documenting one directly. The Postman API is documented (postman-docs-5), and an OpenAPI spec is published at learning.postman.com/openapi.json (postman-probe-3). The Public API Network lets users find shared APIs (postman-docs-44), and the API client can send requests directly from the quick-start (postman-docs-28, postman-docs-31). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an interactive API reference page with inline runnable examples (e.g., try-it or Run in Postman on reference docs), evidence that the Postman API reference itself is runnable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
